infobox.usage: Unlocks the outer door to the KIBA firearms store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Kiba Arms outer door key (KIBA outer) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the outer door of the KIBA Arms International outlet at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- This is the first of two keys required to enter the KIBA firearms store. The second one is the Kiba Arms inner grate door key.
- Requires the Interchange power station switch to be on in order to be used

- 3 seconds after opening the door an alarm will start ringing in the store and across other stores. It can be switched off at a designated terminal.

- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Provocation

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text:
- In the power station office, on a box in the metal shelf next to the cabinet

- At the campsite in the Goshan store, behind the two tents

The Goshan store

The campsite

Key location

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Located on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange, near the center of the mall.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: A second locked grate door that requires the Kiba Arms inner grate door key to be opened. Visit the grate door key page for details of loot available in the store.
